description: The CustomVisualization block as both sides read it: the backend class CustomVisualizationConversationWidget (measureSourceBytes, isRunnable, getLibraryNamesOutsideTheAllowList) and the frontend parser parseCustomVisualizationPayload must agree on every case — the source bytes (UTF-8 of html + css + script + the compact JSON of data), whether the block runs and why not. The data of these cases uses integers and strings only: a float such as 1.0 or a U+2028 character encodes differently in PHP's json_encode and JavaScript's JSON.stringify.

cases.name: the Solar System Explorer of the preview fixture (ChatGPT reference 53)
umlauts and a euro sign count as their UTF-8 bytes
a library outside the allow-list is not run
an allow-listed library with odd spelling still counts as allowed
neither html nor script is not run
one byte above the cap is not run
